article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Snow Days Return)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing the seasonal Snow Days event in Snowhill, with the Gifting Tree presents, Candi Ivy's daily quest, the Abominable Snowman attacks and snowball fights, Everett's coal request, Robgoblin fights, and Snow Days outfits. The article gives no numbers and no exact post date; the relative 'posted 1 week, 4 days ago' against the 2010-12-19 capture suggests early December 2010.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event announcement for the Snow Days season party in the Wintery Basin fishing area above Snowhill. It gives the two scheduled server 1 times (Dec 9 for US/Latin America, Dec 10 for UK/Europe) and asks players to wear wintery outfits and bring boomboxes. The posting date is not shown; it was posted roughly five days before the December 14, 2010 capture.

article_summaries.title: Días de Nieve ah Regresado (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing the return of the Snow Days (Días de Nieve) seasonal event in Snowhill (Colina Nevada). It describes the Gifting Tree gift drops, the Abominable Snowman raids that players repel with snowballs, and the daily tree quest, snowball fights, Robgoblin fights, and outfit rewards. The post gives no absolute date; it says only 'posted 5 months, 3 weeks ago' relative to the capture.

article_summaries.title: Días de Nieve ah Regresado (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing the return of the Snow Days seasonal event in Snowhill (called Colina Nevada in Spanish). It covers the Gift Tree and its daily gifts, the Abominable Snowman attacks that players defend against with snow piles, snowball battles, Robgoblin fights for event clothing, and Snow Days outfits. The post is undated; it says it was posted 5 months, 3 weeks before the 2011-06-04 capture.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Les Jours de Neige: Récompenses aux Membres!)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing Snow Days (Les Jours de Neige) member rewards. Members who held or bought a membership before the deadline got a tiered reward pack, starting Wednesday 15 December 2010 at 21:00 CET, arriving within two to three days. The post's exact posting date is not shown; it is roughly five months and three weeks before the June 2011 capture.

article_summaries.title: Premios para Miembros de Días de Nieve (Free Realms - What is New?, article 1967)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing Snow Days member rewards. Members in good standing were to receive a reward pack at noon on Wednesday December 15 (delivery starting December 16, taking two to three days), with contents set by the membership plan active at the deadline. The page gives no year, so the 2010 date is inferred from the weekday and is not stated.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party Tuesday!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?

It also explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar and the GO button.

article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party Tuesday!

article_summaries.title: Community Event: House Party Tuesday!

A Community Team character named "House Party" teleports to featured houses, and players can reach the event through the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?

It also explains how to find community events via the Game Guide calendar and its GO button.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a short 2010 news stub on the official Free Realms site pointing players to the latest developer blog entry, titled 'February Update and the Festival of Hearts'. It confirms the Festival of Hearts was featured in February 2010 and that the blog covered upcoming work, but gives no concrete details itself. The relative post date ('3 days, 15 hours ago') cannot be converted to an exact date from the capture alone.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (French post: Un Paquet JCC du Festival des Cœurs)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing a limited-time Festival of Hearts Trading Card Game bundle. It lists the bundle's contents (booster packs, promo cards and a loot card for the Emo Raptor), says the offer ends with the Festival of Hearts, and explains that it is bought from the Marketplace with Station Cash. The page gives no date beyond 'Posted 1 year, 3 months ago' relative to the capture.

article_summaries.title: Meet Cudip
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post introducing Cudip, an NPC found in Merry Vale during the Festival of Hearts, who experiments with magical petals collected from heart flowers. He asks players to volunteer for sample collection and gives a small reward each time, so players are told to speak to him every day. The post gives no exact date beyond 'posted 3 days, 16 hours ago' relative to capture.

article_summaries.title: A la Rencontre de Cudipon (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language Free Realms news post introducing Cudipon, an NPC who appears in the Joyful Valley (Vallée Joyeuse) during the Festival of Hearts. He experiments on magic petals picked from flowers that bloom during the festival and asks players to volunteer for sample collection, rewarding them with small gifts for each collection help. The post is dated only relatively ('1 year, 3 months ago' at the 2011-06-04 capture), so its exact date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: The Festival of Hearts Returns
article_summaries.summary: SOE's news post announces the return of the annual Festival of Hearts in Merry Vale, a seasonal event tied to the legend of the pixies Rylan and Arianna and a dark creature called Stone Heart. It lists daily quests, Members Only quests, and Station Cash and Coin Shop items, and explains how to reach the festival via the Merry Vale Warpstone. The post gives no exact dates, prices or rewards.

article_summaries.title: El Festival anual de Corazones ha Regresado (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing the return of the annual Festival of Hearts in Vegalegre, with its love story of the pixies Rois and Araiana, daily and members-only quests, Station Cash and Coin Shop items, and new outfits arriving the following week. It also describes the villain Stone Heart (Corazón Pétreo), who appears when the special flower blooms and whose annual arrival inspires some Cash Shop and Coin Shop items. The page gives no exact post date; the relative stamp '4 months, 1 day ago' against the 2011-06-04 capture implies about early February 2011, which is an inference.
